description: Task extraction from SCHEDULING emails. Tests the recommendedActions field from analyzeEmails(). Each email tested 3 times with majority voting. Expected actions are concise staff tasks (3-10 words, beginning with verbs).

cases.subject: Need to reschedule Thursday appointment
cases.body: Hi, I need to move my appointment scheduled for this Thursday at 2pm. I have a work conflict. Can we do Friday morning instead? I'm flexible between 9am-11am. Thanks!

cases.subject: Appointment availability next week?
cases.body: Hello, I'm a current patient and would like to book my next session. Do you have any openings next Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon? Preferably after 3pm. Please let me know what times work. Thank you.

cases.subject: Confirm appointment for July 8th
cases.body: Just wanted to confirm my appointment for Monday July 8th at 10:30am. Is this still on your calendar? I'll plan to arrive 10 minutes early for paperwork. See you then.

cases.subject: Cancel and rebook appointment
cases.body: I need to cancel my Friday appointment due to a family emergency. Can we reschedule for sometime next week? I'm available Monday, Wednesday or Thursday mornings. Sorry for the short notice.
expectedActions: Reschedule for Monday Wednesday or Thursday morning

cases.subject: Follow-up appointment booking
cases.body: Dr. Song asked me to schedule a follow-up in 2 weeks. I'd like to book something around the same time as my last visit - Tuesday afternoon around 2-3pm if possible. Let me know what's available. Thanks!

cases.subject: Running 15 minutes late for today's appointment
cases.body: Hi, I'm stuck in traffic and will be about 15 minutes late for my 2pm appointment today. So sorry! Should I still come or do we need to reschedule? Please let me know ASAP. Thanks for understanding.
expectedActions: Confirm patient can still come 15 min late

cases.subject: New patient - requesting initial consultation
cases.body: Hello, I was referred by Dr. Kim and would like to schedule an initial consultation for lower back pain. I'm available most weekday afternoons. What's your next available new patient slot? I have Blue Cross insurance. Thank you.
expectedActions: Schedule initial consultation for new patient

cases.subject: Requesting earlier appointment time
cases.body: I have an appointment next Thursday at 4pm but was hoping to come in earlier that day if possible. Do you have any cancellations or openings between 10am-1pm? I'm flexible on the exact time. Let me know, thanks!
expectedActions: Move Thursday 4pm appointment to earlier slot
